nodes.description: Private string state variable holding the ERC20 token name inherited from ERC20Detailed.
Private string state variable holding the ERC20 token symbol inherited from ERC20Detailed.
Private uint8 state variable holding the ERC20 decimals inherited from ERC20Detailed.
Private mapping(address => uint256) tracking token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Constant token name string 'Meta Mask Swap' used at construction time.
Constant token symbol string 'METM' used at construction time.
Constant uint8 tokenDecimals = 18 used at construction time.
Total token supply initialized to 90000000000000000000000 and decreased on burns.
Public uint256 basePercent = 100 used by findOnePercentb for percentage maths.
Caller-controlled address that owns balances, allowances and burn rights across the contract.
Payable constructor that configures name/symbol/decimals and mints the whole initial supply to msg.sender.
Public view returning the current _totalSupply.
Public view returning the balance of a given owner address.
Public view returning the allowance an owner granted to a spender.
Public view computing a rounded one-percent value from an arbitrary input using ceil/mul/div.
External-facing transfer that debits msg.sender, credits the recipient and burns zero tokens.
Public batch transfer looping over receiver/amount arrays and calling transfer for each entry.
Public approval that writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender] to the supplied value.
Public transferFrom checking balance and allowance before moving tokens and reducing allowance.
Public function adding addedValue to the caller's allowance for a spender.
Public function subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for a spender.
Internal one-time mint that credits an account and emits a Transfer from address(0).
External burn that delegates to _burn for msg.sender.
Internal burn reducing _totalSupply and the account balance, emitting Transfer to address(0).
External burnFrom that consumes msg.sender allowance then burns the account's tokens.
Subtraction _balances[msg.sender].sub(value) inside transfer performing balance arithmetic.
Addition _balances[to].add(tokensToTransfer) inside transfer crediting the recipient.
Subtraction _balances[from].sub(value) inside transferFrom performing balance arithmetic.
Addition _balances[to].add(tokensToTransfer) inside transferFrom crediting the recipient.
Subtraction _allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(value) inside transferFrom reducing allowance.
Subtraction of amount from _totalSupply and account balance inside _burn.
Chained ceil/mul/div percentage arithmetic inside findOnePercentb on user-supplied value.
Unbounded for-loop over receivers.length inside multiTransfer that can exhaust gas.
Subtraction of amount from _allowed[account][msg.sender] inside burnFrom.
Parameter 'to' (recipient address) of transfer.
Parameter 'value' (amount) of transfer.
Local var tokensToBurn initialized to 0 inside transfer.
Local var tokensToTransfer computed from value.sub(tokensToBurn) inside transfer.
Parameter 'receivers' address array of multiTransfer.
Parameter 'amounts' uint256 array of multiTransfer.
Loop counter i inside multiTransfer.
Parameter 'spender' of approve.
Parameter 'value' of approve.
Parameter 'from' address of transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' address of transferFrom.
Parameter 'value' amount of transferFrom.
Parameter 'addedValue' of increaseAllowance.
Parameter 'subtractedValue' of decreaseAllowance.
Parameter 'account' of _mint.
Parameter 'amount' of _mint.
Parameter 'amount' of burn.
Parameter 'account' of _burn.
Parameter 'amount' of _burn.
Parameter 'account' of burnFrom.
Parameter 'amount' of burnFrom.
Parameter 'owner' of balanceOf.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance.
Parameter 'owner' of allowance.
Parameter 'value' of findOnePercentb.
Local var roundValue = value.ceil(basePercent) inside findOnePercentb.
Local var onePercent computed and returned by findOnePercentb.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the address whose balance is debited by transfer.
msg.sender allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender owns the allowance being written by approve.
increaseAllowance modifies the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance modifies the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
burn destroys tokens from the msg.sender balance.
burnFrom consumes the msg.sender allowance of the target account.
constructor mints the entire initial supply to msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_burn reduces the balance entry of the target account.
transferFrom validates and reduces the _allowed entry.
approve writes the _allowed mapping.
increaseAllowance adds to the _allowed mapping.
decreaseAllowance subtracts from the _allowed mapping.
burnFrom checks and consumes _allowed[account][msg.sender].
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer recomputes _totalSupply after the zero burn.
transferFrom recomputes _totalSupply after the zero burn.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _totalSupply.
findOnePercentb reads basePercent for its rounding maths.
constructor forwards tokenName into the ERC20Detailed constructor.
constructor forwards tokenSymbol into the ERC20Detailed constructor.
constructor forwards tokenDecimals into the ERC20Detailed constructor.
transfer executes the sender balance subtraction.
Subtraction result is written back into _balances[msg.sender].
transfer executes the recipient balance addition.
Addition result is written back into _balances[to].
transferFrom executes the source balance subtraction.
Subtraction result is written back into _balances[from].
transferFrom executes the recipient balance addition.
Addition result is written back into _balances[to].
transferFrom subtracts the spent value from the caller's allowance.
Reduced allowance is written back into _allowed[from][msg.sender].
_burn performs the totalSupply and balance subtractions.
Subtraction result is written back into _totalSupply.
findOnePercentb performs chained ceil/mul/div arithmetic on user input.
multiTransfer contains the unbounded receiver/amount loop.
burnFrom subtracts the amount from the caller's allowance.
Reduced allowance is written back into _allowed[account][msg.sender].
multiTransfer calls transfer sequentially for each receiver.
burn internally calls _burn.
burnFrom internally calls _burn after consuming allowance.
constructor calls _mint once to create the initial supply.
Recipient parameter 'to' flows into transfer.
Amount parameter 'value' flows into transfer.
tokensToBurn local is defined and used inside transfer.
tokensToTransfer local carries the credited amount inside transfer.
receivers array parameter drives the multiTransfer loop.
amounts array parameter drives the multiTransfer loop.
Loop counter i controls the unbounded multiTransfer loop.
spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by approve.
value parameter becomes the new allowance in approve.
from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
value parameter is the amount moved and allowance spent in transferFrom.
addedValue parameter is added to the allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
account parameter is the mint recipient.
amount parameter is the minted quantity.
amount parameter is forwarded to _burn by burn.
account parameter is the balance debited by _burn.
amount parameter is the burned quantity in _burn.
account parameter is the allowance owner in burnFrom.
amount parameter is both the allowance spent and the burned quantity.
owner parameter indexes the _balances reads in balanceOf.
spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup in allowance.
owner parameter indexes the allowance lookup in allowance.
value parameter is the arithmetic input of findOnePercentb.
roundValue local holds the ceil result inside findOnePercentb.
onePercent local holds and returns the computed percentage.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient address parameter only carries data into transfer and should be normalized into it.
The value parameter is a scalar input of transfer and should be merged into the function node.
tokensToBurn is a temporary local of transfer with no standalone semantic identity.
tokensToTransfer is an intermediate local of transfer that should collapse into it.
receivers array parameter is only meaningful inside multiTransfer.
amounts array parameter is only meaningful inside multiTransfer.
Loop index i exists solely to drive the unbounded multiTransfer loop.
spender parameter feeds the allowance write in approve.
value parameter is the allowance assigned by approve.
from parameter selects the account manipulated by transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit target of transferFrom.
value parameter is the moved and allowance-reducing amount in transferFrom.
addedValue is the direct arithmetic input of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is the direct arithmetic input of decreaseAllowance.
account parameter is the credit target inside _mint.
amount parameter is the minted quantity inside _mint.
amount parameter is forwarded from burn into the burn logic.
account parameter is the debited balance owner inside _burn.
amount parameter is the quantity subtracted inside _burn.
account parameter is the allowance owner inside burnFrom.
amount parameter drives the allowance subtraction inside burnFrom.
owner parameter is only used to index the _balances read in balanceOf.
spender parameter is only used for the nested allowance lookup.
owner parameter is only used for the nested allowance lookup.
value parameter is the sole arithmetic input of findOnePercentb.
roundValue local is an intermediate result inside findOnePercentb.
onePercent local is the returned intermediate of findOnePercentb.
